monsters.name: Pfahlbohrer
monsters.description: a huge grey shipworm as thick as a barrel bursting out of a black oak stilt, a head of overlapping horn plates with a round grinding mouth, wood splinters falling; attack_a: bores forward, attack_b: whips its body and splinters fly

monsters.name: Ertrunkener Ratsherr
monsters.description: a drowned councillor in a robe of kelp over a faded green council gown, a chain of office tarnished green, sitting on a chair stuck in the mud and reading a dripping ledger, pale blue skin, empty polite face; attack_a: reads a sentence aloud (green glyph-less ripples), attack_b: slams down a wax seal

monsters.name: Kellerkrebs
monsters.description: a crayfish the size of a dog, dark rust-brown shell encrusted with shards of old wine bottles, two oversized claws, long feelers; attack_a: claw pinch, attack_b: buries itself and bursts out

monsters.name: Namensmade
monsters.description: a pale maggot as long as an arm, glistening waxy body with faint smeared letter-like marks that are not real letters, a small round mouth that sucks; occult turquoise glow inside; attack_a: lunges and sucks, attack_b: sweats wax drops that fly up

monsters.name: Der Ertrunkene Bürgermeister
monsters.description: the drowned mayor of a sunken town, a tall gaunt man in a rotten black-green mayoral coat and tricorn, a heavy gold chain of office tangled with seaweed, water running from his sleeves, behind him faint silhouettes of his drowned townsfolk standing in the mud

jobs.prompt:
STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, in the readable, cozy-clean style of classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.
Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial city called Kettlegate with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
SETTING OVERRIDE: Wexmoor, a sinking coastal peat marsh town. The drowned Old Town is three centuries older: muddy cobbles, gothic stone gables, green copper, algae, black oak stilts descending from the village above. Use the attached sprites as strict style reference: same palette, outline color, pixel density, proportions and light direction. No actual writing, letters, numbers, labels or watermark anywhere.

Bestiary illustration card, logical 96x128 pixels, opaque aged bone parchment with thin ornamental border in the style reference. Show a huge grey shipworm as thick as a barrel bursting out of a black oak stilt, a head of overlapping horn plates with a round grinding mouth, wood splinters falling. Full creature facing left in upper three quarters with a hint of flooded cobbles behind it. Lower panel blank parchment. NO text, no imitated writing, no decorative lines resembling handwriting. Crisp restrained pixel art; do not copy a reference creature. Preserve distinctive anatomy and readable silhouette.
